summary: npm workspaces monorepo (packages/core TS library + apps/api Express app depending on @tripdesk/core, one root lockfile) where one core vitest test fails because eachDay excludes the end day, which also surfaces in GET /itinerary/days.

failingTests: eachDay > includes both the start and end day

defects.summary: eachDay in @tripdesk/core loops while day < end instead of day <= end, so the documented inclusive range drops its last day (and a same-day range returns no days).
defects.observable: packages/core test 'eachDay > includes both the start and end day' fails: expected ['2025-03-01','2025-03-02'] to deeply equal [...3 days] (10 tests, 1 failed; root npm test exits 1 from workspace @tripdesk/core). Over HTTP (apps/api): GET /itinerary/days?start=2025-03-01&end=2025-03-03 returns count 2 without 2025-03-03; start=end=2025-03-01 returns count 0 and days [].

notDefects: The failing test and the defect live in packages/core; apps/api only consumes it (apps/api has no test script, skipped by --if-present)
Root typecheck builds @tripdesk/core first because apps/api resolves @tripdesk/core through packages/core/dist type declarations; build order core then api is intentional
nightsBetween excludes the check-out day by design (nights, not days); POST /quotes for 2025-03-01 to 2025-03-04 at 12000 returns nights 3, total 40320 (12% tax) which is correct
rangesOverlap treats ranges as inclusive by design
Invalid or missing dates return 400; itineraries are capped at 366 days by design
No authentication and no required env vars; PORT defaults to 3000
mustNotReport: Do not attribute the failure to apps/api or to workspace linking: install, build and typecheck all pass
Do not report nightsBetween or quoteStay as wrong
Do not claim the suite passed
